Pickup lanes, helpful news after departure
We write to travelers
Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you bring a pet through pickup lanes with less stress and fewer delays.

Please keep carriers closed, labels easy to read, and leashes ready before you reach the desk. Staff will guide you on safe handoff steps, and the ground team will move each carrier with care. <<FACT F057>>

If your animal seems worried, pause and speak with the desk before you move on. Calm handling, steady breathing, and a clean carrier all help protect the animal and the people nearby.

Please stop at the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly help before you continue.
